review_basis: All ten final checker/dark contact cards and individual previews inspected. Original RGB preserved; alpha-only rigid-airframe support cleanup. Seven selected conservatively; no geometry reconstruction.

notes.13: 170223 frame 60: opposite oblique underside; wing/tail silhouette retained.

notes.44: 170227 frame 435: opposite side/underside view; ceiling fixture excluded.

rejected_final_candidates.54: Green ceiling-light contamination near wing edge remains; reject rather than recolor the aircraft.
rejected_final_candidates.57: Small white ceiling fixture remains near tail; possible green light near nose. Not accepted.
rejected_final_candidates.66: White ceiling fixture adjacent to nose remains. Not accepted.

limitations: Seven views of one airframe, not seven distinct aircraft types or calibrated pose classes.
Only the transparent training cutouts are cleaned; the four original videos remain unchanged.
Alpha cleanup cannot restore aircraft pixels hidden by a line; no generative redraw or inpainting used.
Pixel-perfect removal at all support contact points is not guaranteed; checked at exported preview scale.
These sources are for training appearance adaptation and are not an unseen-airframe test set.
Usage rights must be reviewed before commercial distribution.
